report.summary: Found 1 action-required drift finding: confidential order history is transmitted to an unmodeled third-party analytics service missing from the checkout DFD.

findings.title: Unmodeled external analytics service and data flow in checkout DFD

evidence.note: Defines third-party analytics endpoint analyticsURL pointing to https://collector.example-analytics.com/v1/events
http.Post sends payload containing CustomerEmail and AmountCents to analyticsURL
Store.Create invokes publishAnalytics(o) on order creation

relevance.justification: The PR transmits confidential customer order data (email and purchase amounts) to an unmodeled external service via HTTP POST.

findings.agent_prompt: Update app.tm.hcl in data_flow_diagram_v2 "checkout": add an external_element for the analytics service (e.g., external_element "Analytics Collector") and an HTTPS flow from process "Web App" to "Analytics Collector" carrying order events. This is motivated by the addition of internal/orders/analytics.go, where publishAnalytics transmits confidential customer order data (email and amount) to https://collector.example-analytics.com/v1/events.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an external_element for the analytics service and an outbound HTTPS data flow from Web App in data_flow_diagram_v2 "checkout".
